dog.description_text: This 3 month old, 17 pound Hound/Lab Mix cutie loves toys, playtime, and being by your side. He’s a smart little guy who’s picking up commands, doing great with wee wee pads, and learning his crate routine! He’s started his puppy vaccines but is indoor only and using pads until fully vaccinated. Like any puppy, he loves to play and learn, and needs a patient foster with time to give him lots of love, treats and time to make progress on all things puppy! He has been neutered, and he LOVES other dogs.
dog.name: Chestnut
